description: This Java class defines constants related to authorization within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes string constants for message bus addresses, field names, and authorization outcomes, as well as a utility method to create authorization request messages.

classes.name: AuthorizationConstants
classes.description: A utility class containing static constants for authorization-related message fields and outcomes, plus a method to generate authorization messages.

methods.name: getAuthorizationMsg
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject message for checking authorization for a specific subject, resource, and permission.
